releaseNotes.technical: forge plan runs plugin/src/spec/citation.mjs over the plan text before the first tracker call, behind hasTree(). identifiersIn spans the clause prefixes and the tree's FOREIGN ones; citationsIn is that list filtered back to a clause prefix, so every clause digest is unchanged.
releaseNotes.userFacing: If your project keeps a requirements tree, forge plan now checks what a plan cites before it stores anything. An identifier that names no clause is refused with the closest ones it could have meant, and one written against a revision the clause has moved past is refused with the revision to write instead. Nothing is stored when a citation is refused, so you fix it in the file you are still holding. A project with no tree sees none of this.
